title: ci(test): store junit results for e2e tests
body:
**Summary**

Junit summary can be used to give a clean output in CircleCI of which tests have failed

**Result**

* adds @wdio/junit-reporter
* sets up junit report on CircleCI

example for the report:

* passing: https://app.circleci.com/pipelines/github/algolia/instantsearch.js/6322/workflows/0e52b9b3-35be-4f17-ab65-de7d08d5fc78/jobs/30033/tests
* failing: https://app.circleci.com/pipelines/github/algolia/instantsearch.js/6323/workflows/e96ac99e-beba-449d-82a4-d0e250257486/jobs/30039/tests
